source: const fs=require('fs'),assert=require('assert/strict'),{chromium}=require('playwright');(async()=>{const b=await chromium.launch({executablePath:process.env.CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE||'/usr/bin/chromium',args:['--no-sandbox']}),p=await b.newPage({reducedMotion:'reduce'}),errors=[],requests=[];p.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));p.on('request',r=>requests.push(r.url()));const records=[];for(const [device,width,height]of[['desktop',1440,1000],['mobile',390,844]]){await p.setViewportSize({width,height});const response=await p.goto(process.env.INFO_WEB+'/lol-coach/game-info.html');assert.equal(response.status(),200,'manual comparison page missing');await p.waitForSelector('#compare-items:enabled');assert.equal(await p.locator('#local-game-read').isDisabled(),true);await p.locator('#item-example').click();await p.locator('#compare-items').click();assert.match(await p.locator('#comparison-result').innerText(),/100/);assert.match(await p.locator('#cash-value').innerText(),/미확인/);assert.match(await p.locator('#earned-value').innerText(),/미확인/);assert(!/승률|확정 승리/.test(await p.locator('#comparison-result').innerText()));await p.locator('#item-patch').fill('16.19');await p.locator('#compare-items').click();assert.match(await p.locator('#comparison-result').innerText(),/미확인/);await p.locator('#item-patch').fill('16.20');await p.locator('#ours-0').fill('999999');await p.locator('#compare-items').click();assert.match(await p.locator('#comparison-result').innerText(),/미확인/);await p.locator('#item-example').click();await p.locator('#compare-items').focus();await p.keyboard.press('Enter');assert.match(await p.locator('#comparison-result').innerText(),/100/);assert(await p.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth));await p.screenshot({path:process.env.INFO_OUT+'/'+device+'.png',fullPage:true});records.push({device,result:await p.locator('#comparison-result').innerText(),timers:await p.locator('#timer-capabilities').innerText()});}assert.equal(errors.length,0,errors.join('\n'));assert(!requests.some(x=>x.includes('/dev/')||x.includes(':2999')||x.includes('api.riotgames')));fs.writeFileSync(process.env.INFO_OUT+'/result.json',JSON.stringify({passed:true,records,external_provider_requests:0,real_client_verified:false},null,2));await b.close();})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)});
